authority.source: the owner's answers of 2026-10-08 to the per-graphic replacement grill: an on-air graphic keeps its version until it is cleared or replaced (Out, All out, Stop/Clear, a replacing Take), with live content still reaching it and no Apply button, the same on browser outputs and CasparCG, a compact waiting status shown only when relevant; each output swaps on its own with no protocol change; shared fields keep updating live, new fields appear after the swap, renames keep identity and removed fields never break live controls, with no versioned panels
